_meta.purpose: Structured brief of the existing Full Pool Services site for rebuilding it; facts pulled exactly from the live site.
caveats: The /testimonials and /gallery pages are unfinished Lorem-ipsum placeholders with stock photos and fake out-of-state names (Maria Walton/Grand Rapids, Jose Hines/Washington, Karen Murphy/Miami) — NOT real reviews. The only real testimonials are the three in the Home page 'Google Reviews' section, captured below.

Price discrepancies exist between the homepage hero banner and the service cards: Acid Wash hero says $595, service card says $599; Tile Cleaning hero says $550, service card says $499; Monthly hero says $140, Weekly card says $150. Both values recorded per service.

Site markets '20+ years of Experience' but states 'since 2011' (company is ~14 yrs old); Yelp 'about' separately states ~8 yrs in business with technicians of 14+ yrs experience. The '20+ years' refers to combined/technician experience, not company age.
No email address is published anywhere on the site; contact is phone + web form only.
